title: dactylorhiza incarnata subsp. ochroleuca
intro: Dactylorhiza incarnata subsp. ochroleuca, commonly known as the white helleborine, is a subspecies of orchid plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. It is a perennial plant that grows in woodland areas and is known for its white or yellowish-green flowers. The health benefits of Dactylorhiza incarnata subsp. ochroleuca include its ability to lower blood sugar levels and improve insulin sensitivity, making it a potential treatment for type 2 diabetes. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardiovascular protective effects.
